content_fields.title: Rate-limit authentication and expensive endpoints (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Rate-limit the authentication and password-reset endpoints, which are the cheapest targets for credential guessing.
content_fields.finding: The token endpoint carries no rate-limit decorator, so password guessing is unthrottled.
criteria: /token, /register, /reset-password and /reset-password/new-password each carry an explicit limit.
The sixth login attempt within a minute from one source returns 429.
Limits are keyed on both source address and submitted username.
